objective: Protect diverse non-reconstructible local model capabilities, especially independent uncensored weights, small practical trained originals, and specialty models, against uncertain future distribution restrictions without violating model rights or capacity.

rules.selection_stage: The 14 rows are precise source-format choices and priority, not legal clearance or an executable download queue.

certainty_classes.observed: Publisher release, access, fixed snapshot LFS SHA and published author quality
certainty_classes.hypothesis: Future legal/regulatory removal waves, not model-specific disappearance prediction
certainty_classes.unverified: User's access, rights, final SHA set, physical actual drive capacity, offline dependencies and quality.

rights_first_gated_models.reason: Gated BF16 original, separate publisher/weight-edit outcome; personal access entitlement must be granted before any model file lock or download.
Small geometrically distinct trained quantum error decoder; currently Gated, rights first.
Separate learned surface-code decoder; currently Gated and publisher LICENSE varies from ColorCode.
Gated robot video/action learned original; must close Qwen & Wan runtime, actual capacity and rights.

retain_not_now_download.reason: Publisher reports refusal 97%->12%, but perplexity 16.26->21.26 and inherits Qwen original terms with no standalone license text; not an independent matched-quality proof.
Publisher has immutable BF16 55.59GB original but marketing comparisons unreplicated, Qwen3.8 edit overlap, and current full-archive capacity unmeasured.
LTX2.5 original Gated parent, Gemma/VAE dependencies and full learned parameter count and donor/license rights unclosed.
Separate trained/multi-stage merge not yet proven superior to existing LTX or overlapping edited variants, total trained components and donor terms unclosed.
180B total; only individual measured quantized runtime exception per policies/limits.json could allow preservation; no proof yet.
~1.05T total, Q2 example alone not enough; >150B individually measured quantized exception not met.

policy_observations.statement: Gated publisher repos require individual authorization in original host flow; listing alone not acquired rights.
OSS exemption partial; no observed blanket prohibition of published weights local storage.
2026-11-15 remote advanced compute access controls not blanket prohibition of local existing open-weight models.

source_limitations: Exa app search/fetch failed HTTP 402 credit exhaustion on 2026-11-18, so external discovery is incomplete. No Exa evidence is claimed.
Hugging Face connected metadata and publisher first-party API via direct read were used. No checkpoint tensor payload was downloaded or executed.
Current historical v45 proxy storage residual ~27.4GB has no measured disk physical capacity and cannot be used to authorize 14 simultaneous downloads.
Author-provided behavior and quality studies (0bserverx, Interpretic, chatrlabs) not reproduced on matched hardware or independent held-out prompts.
0bserverx RVN multilingual Q4+projector and Interpretic Q4+projector are different edited/trained outcomes, but do not download both merely to fill a collection; compare use and measured space.
Chatrlabs Qwen Image LoRA 671MB requires existing base Qwen Image 2.1 and components, plus noncommercial research rights; not standalone executable model.
required_owner_steps: Verify allowed intended acts and individual Gated permissions separately: no gated bypass, no redistributable assumption from HF license metadata.
Run read-only local physical-HDD free/format volume/cache/staging audit on actual archive device, not source-only arithmetic.
Pin all needed code, licenses, notices and learned dependency snapshots; exclude pickle/trust_remote_code execution until audited.
Collect explicit user approval for immutable acquisition file list and exact budget, then only authorized downloading with SHA and offline restoration.
